{{Top}}
[[File:Musician.jpg|thumb|Musicians were primarily entertainers.]]
'''Musicians''', sometimes called '''recording artists''', were beings who sang or played [[Music/Legends|music]] with any number of instruments. There were both [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] musicians and [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Musician droid|musicians]].
